notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.notes:
[i]Paco and the Tumbling Seed Box v1.3.1[/i]:
[list]
[*]Optimizes level graphics loading
[*]Adds support for standard gamepads
[/list]

Let me know what you think: I have LT rotate the box counterclockwise and RT rotate clockwise. This seems natural until seeds get to the exit, at which time it feels backwards...

notes.title: Version 1.2.5
notes.notes: [i]Paco and the Tumbling Seed Box v1.2.5[/i] fixes a game-breaking issue with the game not loading from Steam.

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
This small feature update includes:

1. Better support for vertical screen orientations. Now supports aspect ratios 7:3 through 3:7!
2. Smoother initial game-loading sequence.
